name: midtrans
description: Midtrans (Indonesia): Snap payment pages and Core API transaction status; cancel, expire, refund and capture node only

nodes.title: Create Snap transaction
nodes.description: Create a Snap payment page for an order: returns token and redirect_url (send redirect_url to the payer). No money moves until the payer pays. Agent tools also need MIDTRANS_TOOL_MAX_AMOUNT (as an agent tool only when MIDTRANS_TOOL_ALLOW_PAYMENTS=1)

order_id.description: Your unique order id (letters, digits, - _ ~ .; max 50)

gross_amount.description: Total in IDR (must equal the sum of item_details)

item_details.description: Items: [{id, name, price, quantity, brand?, category?}] (price in IDR)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get transaction status
nodes.description: Status of a transaction by order id: transaction_status (pending, settlement, capture, deny, cancel, expire, refund...), payment_type, gross_amount

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get B2B transaction status
nodes.description: All transactions of one order id (B2B: several payments per order)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
